bottleneck: The key-door benchmark blocks movement because the baseline routes to a visible parcel before collecting the visible access resource.
rationale: When an access resource is observed, collect it first; preserve that evidence in episodic memory, then route the parcel workflow normally. The policy defers completely in environments where no key has been observed.
expectedMetric: Increase key-door-delivery score from 0 to 10 without lowering any holdout score.
source: (context) => { const o = context.observation; const me = o.me; if (!me) return undefined; const collectedAccess = context.memory.some((entry) => entry.module === 'candidate:key-prerequisite-route' && entry.action.kind === 'pickup'); if (o.keys.length === 0 && !collectedAccess) return undefined; const direction = (from, to) => to.x > from.x ? 'right' : to.x < from.x ? 'left' : to.y > from.y ? 'down' : to.y < from.y ? 'up' : undefined; const key = o.keys[0]; if (key) { const step = direction(me, key); return step ? { action: { kind: 'move', direction: step }, confidence: 0.9, rationale: 'Reach the observed access resource before the task.' } : { action: { kind: 'pickup' }, confidence: 1, rationale: 'Collect the co-located access resource.' }; } const carried = o.parcels.find((parcel) => parcel.carriedBy === me.id); const parcel = o.parcels.find((item) => !item.carriedBy); const target = carried ? o.tiles.find((tile) => tile.type === '2') : parcel; if (!target) return undefined; const step = direction(me, target); if (!step) return carried ? { action: { kind: 'putdown' }, confidence: 1, rationale: 'Deliver the carried parcel on the target tile.' } : { action: { kind: 'pickup' }, confidence: 1, rationale: 'Collect the co-located parcel.' }; return { action: { kind: 'move', direction: step }, confidence: 0.8, rationale: 'Continue the prerequisite-aware parcel route.' }; }
